title: Will USDA's National Feeder & Stocker Cattle Summary report a South Dakota medium/large frame #1 steer (500-600 lb) price above $260/cwt in October 2026?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if USDA AMS's National Feeder & Stocker Cattle Summary (or the South Dakota-specific weekly report) shows a weighted average price above $260 per hundredweight for medium/large frame #1 steers (500-600 lbs) in any report published during October 2026; NO otherwise.
falsifier: Wrong if USDA AMS's own National Feeder & Stocker Cattle Summary for October 2026 disagrees with the recorded probability's implied side.
